notes.title: BattleCraft Unleashes Epic Update: Master Control and Bug Squashing Galore!
notes.content:
In a groundbreaking move, the highly acclaimed game BattleCraft has just dropped a colossal update that is set to revolutionize the gaming experience. The team behind the game has not only tackled numerous bugs but has also introduced a game-changing feature - players can now take command of all characters and launch attacks on various opponents across the map.

This grand update comes as a breath of fresh air for BattleCraft enthusiasts, providing them with unparalleled control and strategic depth. Now, gamers can seamlessly switch between characters, orchestrating a symphony of coordinated strikes against their foes. The fix list is extensive, addressing pesky bugs that have been causing headaches for players.

The BattleCraft team is excited to roll out this major update, emphasizing their commitment to delivering a top-notch gaming experience. Players can expect smoother gameplay, enhanced tactics, and an overall more immersive adventure in the BattleCraft universe.

Get ready to dive back into the action-packed world of BattleCraft, where the only limits are your strategy and skill!

notes.title: Battle Craft: Training Menu Enhancements
notes.content:
Hello, dear Battle Craft players! Our team has great news for you!
We continue to work on enhancing your gaming experience and are pleased to introduce fresh changes to the game. This time, we focused on the training menu and made some important improvements:

Improved adaptability of the training menu: Now the training menu has become even more convenient and intuitive. We considered your feedback and optimized the interface so that you can quickly and easily customize your training to meet your own needs.

Dynamic clan filter buttons: We are also excited to present you with the ability to create dynamic clan filter buttons. Now you can easily track and find information about your clan, as well as clans of your opponents. This significantly simplifies your interaction with your friends and allies in the game.

We hope that these updates will make the gameplay more enjoyable and convenient. Thank you for your support and active involvement in the development of Battle Craft. We are always open to your feedback and suggestions, so please don't hesitate to share your ideas with us!
Stay tuned for more news and stay with us because there are more exciting changes ahead. Good luck in battles!

notes.title: Update of Features in Battle Craft: Your Path to Unique Experience!
notes.content:
Greetings to all Battle Craft players!

We are excited to share the latest news from the world of our game. Our development team continues to enhance Battle Craft, and today we have an important update for you.
The character and building attribute system in the game has been significantly improved. We listen to your feedback and work to make your experience in the world of Battle Craft even more engaging and rich.
What does this mean for you?
Now your character becomes even more unique thanks to new attributes. You can customize them to fit your play style and preferences, making battles even more exciting and strategic.

The buildings in your base have not been overlooked either. We have upgraded their attributes, allowing you to manage your resources more effectively and develop your base.
This is just one of the steps on the path to improving the gaming experience in Battle Craft. We continue to work on new features and functions to make our game even more captivating and immersive.

Thank you for your support and dedication to our game. We are always ready to listen to your ideas and suggestions to make Battle Craft better for you.
Don't forget to stay tuned for updates and keep up with all the news. Exciting adventures await you in the world of Battle Craft!

Best regards,
The Battle Craft Development Team

notes.title: Battle Craft: Magic in Action
notes.content:
Greetings, Battle Craft community!
We are excited to share the latest developments in our game with you. Our team continues to work diligently to make Battle Craft even better, and we are pleased to introduce two important updates:

- New Spell Building!
We are delighted to announce that a brand-new building, the Spell Factory, has been added to the game. This is where your strategy can reach new heights! In the Spell Factory, you will be able to research and use powerful spells to aid you in battles. Get ready for thrilling tactical opportunities and unique gameplay moments!

 -Fully Developed Spell System!
We didn't just add a spell-building; we have also fully developed a spell system to make it engaging and balanced. Now, you have access to a variety of spells that will allow you to control the battlefield and influence its outcome. Be prepared for new strategic challenges and opportunities that spells provide!

We are immensely grateful to our dedicated players for your support and loyalty. We continue to work on improvements and adding new content to make Battle Craft the best it can be. Stay tuned for updates and don't forget to share your feedback and ideas with us. Your input is essential to us!
We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield in Battle Craft, where spells and strategies will become your best allies!

notes.title: Battle Craft: Introducing the Epic Update – New Clan and Fresh Mechanics!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EWYRzBV1Nqc;full]

🔊 Sound Innovations: Get ready to dive even deeper into the game's atmosphere with unique sounds! New audio effects for building structures, character appearances in warfare, and sounds of hits on wooden constructions will create an unparalleled impression. Weapon acquisition and building upgrades bring more dynamism to each battle. A comprehensive audio palette allows you to hear the builder's voice and the sounds of placing buildings.

🏗️ The world of Battle Craft gains a new vibrancy with improved building textures. Prepare for a new clan with its unique structures that introduce fresh dimensions to the gameplay. The mechanics of defenders have been reimagined – now they can skillfully jump over fences, unveiling new tactical opportunities. Structure construction has become even smoother and more efficient thanks to implemented optimizations.

🎮 Meet the King, now available in the research menu! You can freely switch between characters in Merlin's cave, expanding your possibilities for exploring the world. Enhanced game menus and optimized code ensure better performance and a more satisfying experience for every player.

🌱 Nature returns in its full splendor! Grass adds a fresh vibrancy and unique charm to the Battle Craft world. We haven't forgotten about artificial intelligence either: errors have been fixed to provide a smooth and pleasant gaming experience. New sound effects will immerse you even deeper into the gameplay, and a progress bar on the training ground will facilitate the mastery of game mechanics.

🏰 Innovative changes to the movement system are in place, involving building, fences, and patrol points. Exciting new methods of interaction with the game world await you!

Continue to stay tuned for updates, as our goal is to make your gaming experience more captivating and unforgettable. Thank you so much for your support! 🎮🛡️[/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🎮 Fresh News from the World of Battle Craft - August 11, 2023
notes.content:

Hello, esteemed Battle Craft players!

📅 A Massive Update Awaits on August 14, 2023!
With great anticipation, we announce the release of a massive update scheduled for August 14, 2023! Prepare for captivating changes, new possibilities, and thrilling adventures in the world of Battle Craft!

We are excited to present you with the latest updates and achievements that our development team has prepared for you. Your feedback and support continue to inspire us for new accomplishments!

Old scripts have been cleaned from prefabs, and lost scripts have been removed.
Fixed the "ESP" button interaction issue with the tutorial.
Corrected errors in the "Lightning" tool window.
Enhanced the sound of the "PointerSound" button.
Fixed flickering walls.
The Cyber clan has been restored, as it somehow didn't transfer.

🛠️ Anya's Achievements:
Fixed loading screens to prevent visibility of the building loading process.
Code improvements have been implemented.

🏗️ Maxim's Contributions:
The new Barbacko clan and new upgradeable buildings are ready.
An upgrade effect has been added to buildings, making this process more engaging.

🛡️ Sergey's Work:
Implemented the ability to bypass fences.
Added mechanics for decapitating characters of the opposing clan.
Tuned long-range attacks for the Barbacko clan characters.

⛏️ Svyat's Progress:
New buildings have been added for the new clan.

🎙️ Vlad's Vocal Enhancements:
Additional voice options have been added for characters.
Voices have also been integrated for the new clan.

Sergiy (information about his work is not provided).

A button for purchasing barracks has been added.

🎨 Yuri's UI Progress:
Work has been conducted on user interface improvements.

Thank you for staying with us and continuing to immerse yourselves in the Battle Craft world! Your support is our main inspiration. Stay tuned for updates; exciting new adventures await you! 🎮🛡️

notes.title: 🎮 Battle Craft News Update 🛡️ 03.08.2023 - 08.08.2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vWR9VmDrGbA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, dear Battle Craft players! We're here with another round of exciting updates to enhance your gameplay experience:

🔊 Sound Innovations:
Prepare to immerse yourself further with new building construction sounds, character appearance sounds in War mode, and the satisfying thuds of hits on wood structures and fences.
The sound of weapon acquisition and building upgrades will make your battles even more engaging.
You'll now hear the voice of the builder and the satisfying sound of placing buildings.

🏗️ Sergey's Improvements:
We're enhancing the textures of buildings to make the world of Battle Craft even more vibrant and realistic.
Get ready for a new clan with unique buildings, bringing a fresh dimension to your gameplay.
Defenders now have an updated mechanic that allows them to leap over fences, introducing exciting tactical possibilities.
Building structures has never been smoother, thanks to optimizations we've implemented.

🎮 Kolya's Enhancements:
Introducing the King in the research menu! You can now switch characters in Merlin's cave for expanded exploration.
We've refined the in-game menus and code for better performance and an enhanced user experience.

🌱 Updates from Anya:
Grass is back in all its glory, adding vibrancy and natural beauty to the world of Battle Craft.
Several bugs have been fixed, making your gaming sessions smoother and more enjoyable.
New sound effects accompany various in-game actions, immersing you even further into the gameplay.
A progress bar has been added to the training camp for more effective learning and training.
🏰 Svyat's Update:

Currently, I'm in the process of refactoring the movement system for building, fences, and patrol points. Get ready for new ways to interact with the game world!
07.08.2023
Continuing the journey of enhancing your gameplay experience:

🤴 Kolya Introduces Changes:
The King is now available in the research menu, along with optimizations to the menu and a transition to the latest version of Unity.
Stay tuned for more updates and opportunities for characters in Merlin's cave!

📊 Innovations from Nikita:
The project has been successfully transferred to a clean version of Unity, allowing us to restore terrain and prepare for new adventures.
The ranking table has also been restored after the project transfer.
A new experience calculation system for characters will enrich the battle experience and add depth to the gameplay.

Hello, Battle Craft players! We've got thrilling news for you:

🌿 Maxim Revitalizes the Environment:

Immerse yourself in the world of high-detail grass, creating a lifelike and immersive atmosphere.
Realistic water, clouds, and sun will make your adventure even more captivating!
Stay tuned for more updates and keep immersing yourself in the world of Battle Craft! We're committed to making your experience as engaging and exciting as possible. Thank you for your support! 🎮🛡️
